title: RIO Receipt
description: A cryptographic receipt proving that an AI-initiated action was authorized, executed, and recorded. Any system implementing the RIO Receipt Protocol MUST produce receipts conforming to this schema.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt. MUST be a v4 UUID.

receipt_type.description: Classification of the receipt. 'governed_action' is the default for standard pipeline actions.

intent_id.description: The intent this receipt covers. Links the receipt to the original action request.

action.description: The action type that was executed (e.g., 'send_email', 'create_pr', 'transfer_funds').

agent_id.description: Identifier of the AI agent or system that requested the action.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or policy that authorized execution. For AUTO_APPROVE actions, this is the policy identifier.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the receipt was generated.

hash_chain.description: The cryptographic hash chain binding intent, governance, authorization, execution, and receipt together.

intent_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical intent object.

governance_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the governance decision.

authorization_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the authorization record.

execution_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the execution result.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the receipt itself, computed from receipt_id + all preceding hashes + timestamp.

verification.description: Metadata describing how to verify this receipt.

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used. MUST be SHA-256.

chain_length.description: Number of hashes in the chain. MUST be 5.

chain_order.description: Ordered list of hash field names in the chain.

ingestion.description: Provenance metadata recording how the original intent entered the system. Optional in v2.1.

source.description: The channel through which the intent was received.

source_message_id.description: Original message ID from the source system.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the intent was received.

identity_binding.description: Ed25519 cryptographic proof binding the receipt to a specific signer identity. Optional in v2.1.

public_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 public key of the signer.

signature_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the payload that was signed.

ed25519_signed.description: Whether this receipt was signed with Ed25519.
